claim_ceiling: This benchmark proves only that REAL cached OpenCaseLaw rows carry the fields the query_result_bundle contract needs (decision_id, canonical_url on mcp.opencaselaw.ch, language, citation strings, statutes, a frozen-marker-rule text surface) and that the ACCEPTED harness rejects a regressed bundle. It does NOT prove that Product builds such a bundle, that the map is useful to a jurist, that counter labels are calibrated (counter_uncertainty is a fixed fixture constant), that the coordinates are a good layout (they are a deterministic fixture layout, not a geometry claim), or anything about the absolute LABEL_SOUND / GEOMETRY_SOUND bars. Recall figures are measured, not thresholded.
evidence_summary: Real cached OpenCaseLaw input (24 HTTP-200 envelopes, written by the accepted frozen retrieval gate from live HTTP 200 responses on 2026-10-14/16) builds source-linked, duplicate-free, geometry-stable bundles for all 4 frozen questions (rent-default, corporate-criminal-liability, business-judgment-rule, petty-theft-dismissal). The accepted harness (evaluate_query_map_bundle) validates all contract checks: source_urls_valid=True, duplicate_free=True, geometry_preserved_after_enrichment=True, progressive_phases=True, answer_citations_constrained=True. Both regressed inputs (blanked counter evidence, broken source URL) are properly rejected, proving the checks are live and not vacuous. Counter-authority discovery yields candidate-limiting labels for 2/4 questions (rent-default: 16 candidates, petty-theft-dismissal: 4 candidates) and is empty for 2/4 (corporate-criminal-liability, business-judgment-rule), honestly reported as a negative result. All three query languages (de, fr, it) are present in the bundle. Zero live network calls during benchmark; no analyst mapping leakage; no threshold tuning; no universal-174k re-run. The claim ceiling explicitly limits what is proven and what remains for product continuation.
